concepts.title: 利落漫画主角
concepts.prompt: Graphic Japanese urban RPG key art, angular confident ink contours, expressive flat cel shading and sharply designed negative space. Three-quarter upper-thigh portrait, body turned, looking toward viewer with a subtle knowing smile. Slim angular black glasses, windswept layered black hair. concepts.title: 街头潮流玩家
concepts.prompt: Contemporary street-fashion action-game character illustration with exaggerated clothing volume, chunky expressive linework, screenprint texture and sculptural cel shading. concepts.title: 复古像素冒险者

concepts.title: 白蛇时装角色
concepts.prompt: High-fashion illustrated game character poster, sophisticated editorial gouache and dry-brush texture, elegant restrained shapes, cool magnetic expression. Upper-thigh portrait of a handsome young man with artfully tousled black hair, eyes unobstructed, no glasses in this variation. Long fluid midnight-blue jacket over a black top, subtle silver fastenings. He gently supports an ivory-white snake across both forearms, loosely referencing the real held-snake pose; show the snake as a calm animal with a coherent single body, one head and one tail. Strong sweeping S-shaped composition between snake and clothing. Warm ivory background, cobalt shadow shapes and a narrow gold rim light. Fashion magazine attitude, polished painterly stylization, no armor, no magical effects.
